Albert Ryan is another with a powerful arm action, promising great things with the Discus. Down in the Boys section there is an even greater state of flux.
Peter Crosbie retained his Youth Javelin title although he was a little disappointed with the distance and Albert Ryan excelled with 2nd place in the Discus.
(1.5Kg) · Albert Ryan · Motspur Park · 14/5/74 · Surrey Yth Champs (2nd) · 32.18

His 13.60 metres shot putt added nearly 2 metres to our previous mark set in 1971, while his discus throw of 36.50 metres put over 4 metres onto a record set by Albert Ryan when placing 2nd in the Surrey Championships in 1974.
